mainEntity.name: What are the common types of bathtubs for replacement and their differences?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common bathtub types for replacement include acrylic, fiberglass, cast iron, and solid surface. Acrylic tubs are lightweight, affordable, and warm to the touch, while fiberglass is similar but less durable. Cast iron tubs are very heavy, durable, and excellent at retaining heat but are more expensive and require robust floor support. Solid surface tubs offer a high-end, seamless look and are highly customizable. When choosing, consider factors like material durability, weight, heat retention, and your budget, as these will impact the installation complexity and long-term satisfaction.
